1 خَمَعَ , (Lth, S, K,) aor.
خَمَعَ , inf. n. خَمْعٌ (Lth, IDrd, K) and خُمُوعٌ (Lth, K) and خَمَعَانٌ, (Az, K,) said of a hyena, (K,) &c., (TA,) He limped, or had a slight lameness, (IDrd, S,) in his gait, or manner of going; (S;) he went as though he had a lameness. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
